name: Suzuki Mai
source: Suzuki Mai is a cheerful 11-year-old rabbit, who is a fragile and a gothic emo who is dressed in Lolita. Mai also brings good luck to Sakura when she is a rabbit. Her birthday is November 20th, 2007.
